{{Top|leg}}
The '''E-11A blaster rifle''' was a heavy blaster produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The E-11A was based on the original designs for the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] that was manufactured for [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].
